experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an outdoor sunrise yoga session along the scenic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud, surrounded by lush jungle and rice fields. The early morning timing avoids midday heat, and many studios offer indoor alternatives in case of rain. A deeply spiritual and physically rewarding experience perfectly aligned with Bali's yoga culture.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset Walk & Swim
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Seminyak Beach, one of Bali's most beautiful stretches of coastline. Arrive around 4:30 PM to enjoy a gentle swim and walk along the shore as temperatures cool. Watch the famous Bali sunset from the beach or a nearby beachfront café. Free to access with optional lounger rentals.

experiences.name: Indoor Yoga & Meditation Retreat Day
experiences.description: Spend a full morning at one of Ubud's renowned indoor yoga studios such as The Yoga Barn, which offers multiple classes including Hatha, Yin, and guided meditation. The indoor setting is ideal during midday heat or rainy weather. Many packages include access to multiple classes throughout the day, making it excellent value for yoga enthusiasts.

experiences.name: Nusa Dua Beach Morning Snorkeling
experiences.description: Head to the calm, crystal-clear waters of Nusa Dua Beach for a guided morning snorkeling session. The water is at its calmest and clearest in the early hours, and the beach is well-maintained and less crowded. Snorkeling gear rental and a guide are included. Retreat to a beachside café or resort lobby during midday heat.

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class & Cultural Experience
experiences.description: Join a small-group indoor Balinese cooking class in Seminyak or Ubud, where you'll learn to prepare traditional dishes like Nasi Goreng, Satay Lilit, and Lawar. Classes typically start with a morning market visit and move indoors for cooking, making it a perfect midday heat or rain alternative. A wonderful blend of culture, food, and hands-on activity.
experiences.best_time_of_day: morning to early afternoon (8:00 AM–1:00 PM)
